project_identity.name: GLCC - Grey Lynn Cycle Club
project_identity.tagline: GLCC — Grey Lynn Cycle Club — 4th best cycle club in Grey Lynn
project_identity.theme_archetype: High-Contrast Kinetic Athleticism + Urban Kiwi Cafe Culture
project_identity.emotional_tone: Energetic, precise, tongue-in-cheek community pride, high-visibility tactical dark/light hybrid
project_identity.target_platform: Mobile Web App (React Native / Expo web preview with safe areas, native bottom tabs, bottom sheets)

color_system.mode: Dark Tactical Base with Vivid Hi-Vis Accents

surface_treatment.ride_card: bg-[#161B22] border border-[#30363D] hover:border-[#D4FF00]/50 transition-all rounded-2xl p-5 shadow-lg
surface_treatment.coffee_hero_card: relative overflow-hidden bg-gradient-to-br from-[#2C1E18] to-[#0D1117] border border-[#E67E22]/30 rounded-3xl p-6

font_families.heading: Barlow Condensed, Outfit, sans-serif
font_families.mono_stats: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

layout_and_navigation.structure: Mobile-First Bottom Tab Container (Rides | Coffee | Riders | Chat)
layout_and_navigation.safe_areas: Top header with weather status widget + profile drawer toggle; Bottom fixed tab bar with safe-area padding

bento_grid_specs.dashboard_mode: High Density Single & Double Column Grid (gap-4)
bento_grid_specs.card_padding: p-5 internal padding strictly required to prevent text-border collision

rides_tab.cards: Display Day/Date badge, Ride Name, Distance (km), Elevation (m), Pace (28-31 kph), Cafe stop, Count going avatar stack
rides_tab.ride_detail_modal: Stylized SVG Route map elevation profile, Meet time, Departure location pin, RSVP button trio (Going / Maybe / Can't), Cafe 'Send a Coffee Round' quick action, Going Riders grid

coffee_order_tab.hero: Dramatic dark coffee image background with 'SEND A ROUND' CTA, 'I'm at the Café' geolocation ping
coffee_order_tab.drink_selector: Interactive quick grid with options (Flat White, Oat FW, Long Black, Espresso, Cappuccino, Cold Brew)
coffee_order_tab.live_feed: Real-time stream of recent bought rounds with buyer avatar, timestamp, drink name, and cheer counter

riders_tab.admin_bar: 'View As' persona switcher (El Presidente / Ride Captain / Member / Guest) + 'Register Rider' button
riders_tab.pending_approval: High-visibility banner for pending riders with 1-click Approve/Deny buttons
riders_tab.directory: Grid of Rider Cards (Photo avatar, Name, Role badge e.g. 'Ride Captain', Coffee preference, Admin badge)

chat_tab.header: Live Auckland Weather Header widget ('14°C · Partly cloudy · Auckland')
chat_tab.messages: Differentiated system coffee-round announcement cards + user message bubbles with timestamp & avatar
chat_tab.input: Sticky bottom chat input with image attachment & send button

toast_notifications.style: Sliding top banner dark card with Hi-Vis Volt badge ('GLCC · now') powered by Sonner

motion_and_microinteractions.transitions: Spring animations for tab switches, press state scale (scale: 0.97) on primary CTA buttons, smooth height transitions for ride detail expansion

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components, buttons, tab bars, input fields, RSVP controls, admin action triggers MUST include explicit kebab-case `data-testid` attributes (e.g. data-testid="tab-rides", data-testid="rsvp-going-button", data-testid="coffee-send-round-button")
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: All text elements meet WCAG AA (4.5:1+) against dark backgrounds using bright contrast values (#F0F6FC for headers, #D4FF00 for primary accents).

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a mobile-first UI with responsive container frames (max-w-md mx-auto relative min-h-screen bg-[#0D1117]) that feels like a native iOS/Android cycling app.
Do NOT use generic light beige or plain Inter white defaults. Follow the Dark Tactical Athletic + Volt Accent identity strictly.
Ensure WebSockets or mock real-time events propagate instant UI updates across Chat and Coffee feed.
Include 'View as' switcher to test Admin vs Member roles smoothly.
Apply `data-testid` to every button, card, input, and modal trigger.
